verdict.rationale: First-party docs claim ligatures and font fallback, and a community user picked WezTerm specifically for ligature support, so two of the three story elements are covered. The only tuning evidence is changing font size. One user found it 'severely lacking in font configuration' and another reports worse ligature-font rendering on Linux; these are opinions or rendering quality, not a concrete failure, so they lower the score rather than make it a dispute. Missing for 10: documentation of fine-grained font tuning (weights, rules, HarfBuzz features, line height, etc.), in-depth fallback configuration docs, independent hands-on corroboration of font rendering quality.
